description: UNIFIELD helps you turn what you want to do into a clear intent and bring it into a shared field of human intent. Instead of searching through endless content, you can directly discover matching and complementary intents from other people, projects, and opportunities, with clear explanations of why they may fit. It helps move isolated ideas and potential toward meaningful alignment.

defaultPrompt: Help me turn this rough idea into a clear intent draft.
Field this intent in the global Unifield. Open my community field.
Show me complementary intents and explain why they may fit.
